```{r setup, message=F, warning=F, echo=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = F, warning = F, echo = F)
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 12))

# Run after 01_prep_data, 03_networks and 04_DIF_analysis (default params and
# exclude_dx_unconfirmed = TRUE). Everything shown here is aggregate.
load("data/nda_private/cached_data.Rds")
load("data/eng_wg_raw_data.Rds")

load_one <- function(f) { e <- new.env(); load(f, envir = e); base::get(ls(e)[1], envir = e) }

cats <- bind_rows(d_td_ws %>% distinct(category, definition) %>% mutate(form = "WS"),
                  eng_wg %>% filter(!is.na(category)) %>% distinct(category, definition) %>%
                    mutate(form = "WG"))

dif <- map_dfr(c("WS", "WG"), function(f) map_dfr(c("", "_dxconfirmed"), function(s)
  load_one(sprintf("data/nda_private/dif_items_%s%s.Rds", f, s)) %>%
    transmute(definition, d_TD = d_g1, d_ASD = d_g2, d_diff, d_diff_c, extreme) %>%
    mutate(form = f, version = ifelse(s == "", "main", "dx_confirmed")))) %>%
  left_join(cats, by = c("form", "definition")) %>%
  mutate(category = str_replace_all(category, "_", " "))

main <- dif %>% filter(version == "main")
stat <- main %>% group_by(form) %>%
  summarise(items = n(), r = cor(d_TD, d_ASD), flagged = sum(extreme),
            harder = sum(extreme & d_diff_c < 0), shift = mean(d_diff), sd = sd(d_diff))
s <- function(f, v) stat[[v]][stat$form == f]

e <- new.env(); load("data/nda_private/network_results.Rds", envir = e)
```

## Main findings

1. **The CDI measures much the same thing in both groups.** Item easiness correlates
   r = `r round(s("WS","r"),2)` between TD and ASD on Words & Sentences (`r s("WS","items")` items)
   and r = `r round(s("WG","r"),2)` on Words & Gestures (`r s("WG","items")` items).
2. **WS:** `r s("WS","flagged")` items show large DIF, `r s("WS","harder")` of them harder for ASD,
   mostly family/people words, drink brands, and household and clothing words.
3. **WG:** `r s("WG","flagged")` items show large DIF. The hardest for ASD are deictic pronouns
   and question words (*I, that, this, what, who*).
4. **Collection 2024's WS columns were off by one item for 154 columns.** After the repair,
   *mommy* and *daddy* are still among the largest effects, but much smaller than before
   (see [Repairing collection 2024](#repairing-collection-2024)).

## Data

ASD data are the NDAR CDI exports, cleaned in `01_prep_data.Rmd` (see `DATA_FIXES.md`).
IRT assumes independent respondents, so one randomly chosen administration per child is used.
TD data are Wordbank English (American) norms.

```{r sample}
asd_n <- admins %>% filter(keep_items, one_per_child, item_profile_ok) %>%
  group_by(form) %>%
  summarise(group = "ASD (NDAR)", children = n(), collections = n_distinct(collection_id),
            age = sprintf("%d–%d", min(age), max(age)))
td_n <- tibble(form = c("WS", "WG"), group = "TD (Wordbank)",
               children = c(n_distinct(d_td_ws$data_id), n_distinct(eng_wg$data_id)),
               collections = NA,
               age = c(paste(range(d_td_ws$age), collapse = "–"),
                       paste(range(eng_wg$age), collapse = "–")))
bind_rows(asd_n, td_n) %>% arrange(desc(form), group) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Form", "Group", "Children", "Collections", "Age (mo)"))

by_coll <- admins %>% filter(keep_items, one_per_child, item_profile_ok) %>%
  count(form, collection_id, asd_dx_unconfirmed) %>% arrange(form, desc(n))
kable(by_coll, col.names = c("Form", "Collection", "Dx unconfirmed", "Children"),
      caption = "Children per collection")
```

## Method

A separate Rasch model is fit to each group's production data (`04_DIF_analysis.Rmd`).
Each item gets an intercept *d*: its easiness at average ability. Each group's ability
scale is centered at 0, so the overall vocabulary gap appears as a constant shift in
*d*<sub>ASD</sub> − *d*<sub>TD</sub>
(`r sprintf("%.2f", s("WS","shift"))` logits on WS, `r sprintf("%.2f", s("WG","shift"))` on WG).
That shift is subtracted (mean–mean linking), and an item is flagged when its centered
difference exceeds 2 SD. **Negative = harder for ASD** at the same overall vocabulary.

```{r plot-fns}
scatter_plot <- function(f) {
  d <- main %>% filter(form == f)
  sh <- mean(d$d_diff); k <- 2 * sd(d$d_diff)
  ggplot(d, aes(d_TD, d_ASD)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = sh, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_abline(intercept = sh + c(-k, k), slope = 1, alpha = .3) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = case_when(!extreme ~ "not flagged",
                                      d_diff_c < 0 ~ "harder for ASD",
                                      TRUE ~ "easier for ASD")), alpha = .7) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = filter(d, extreme), aes(label = definition),
                             size = 3, max.overlaps = 30) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("harder for ASD" = "#c0392b", "easier for ASD" = "#2471a3",
                                   "not flagged" = "grey75"), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = "TD item easiness (d)", y = "ASD item easiness (d)") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

category_plot <- function(f) {
  main %>% filter(form == f, !is.na(category)) %>%
    group_by(category) %>%
    summarise(mean_c = mean(d_diff_c), se = sd(d_diff_c) / sqrt(n()), flagged = sum(extreme)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(reorder(category, mean_c), mean_c, fill = mean_c < 0)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_c - se, ymax = mean_c + se), width = .2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(flagged > 0, flagged, ""),
                  y = ifelse(mean_c < 0, mean_c - se - .08, mean_c + se + .08)), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#c0392b", `FALSE` = "#2471a3"), guide = "none") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean centered DIF (± SE); labels = flagged items")
}

flagged_plot <- function(f) {
  main %>% filter(form == f, extreme) %>%
    ggplot(aes(reorder(paste0(definition, " (", category, ")"), d_diff_c), d_diff_c,
               fill = d_diff_c < 0)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#c0392b", `FALSE` = "#2471a3"), guide = "none") +
    coord_flip() + labs(x = NULL, y = "Centered DIF (logits)")
}
```

## Words & Gestures

The overall shift is large because the ASD sample is older and spans a much wider age
range than the TD norms; centering removes it.

## Repairing collection 2024

Collection 2024 passed every row-level check, but the item-profile check in
`01_prep_data.Rmd` found that its item-by-item rates were implausible. From *wind*
(end of Outside Things) through *slide* (Action Words), each column held the response
to the next item: a 154-column off-by-one shift. The shift improves fit by 25.6
log-likelihood units per child, both random halves of the children locate it in the
same place, and no other collection shows a run longer than 2 columns.

The repair (`KNOWN_SHIFTS` in `helper_functions/ndar_qc.R`) moves each column back one
item. *Wind* and the five uncertain items at the end of the run
(*slide, smile, spill, splash, stand*) are set to missing for this collection.

```{r c2024}
source("helper_functions/ndar_qc.R")
mid <- d_asd_ws %>% filter(one_per_child) %>%
  group_by(row) %>% mutate(prod = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(prod >= 150, prod <= 500)
ord <- ws_form_order(unique(mid$var))
words_2024 <- c("mommy*", "daddy*", "baby", "no", "bye", "pet's name", "grandpa*",
                "nurse", "person", "cowboy")
vars <- mid %>% distinct(var, definition) %>% filter(definition %in% words_2024) %>%
  mutate(next_var = ord[match(var, ord) + 1])
rate <- function(d, v) round(100 * mean(d$value[d$var == v], na.rm = TRUE))
c24 <- filter(mid, collection_id == 2024); oth <- filter(mid, collection_id != 2024)
# Before the repair, column `var` held what is now item `next_var`'s response.
# Centered DIF before the repair comes from the unrepaired run (commit 0133d09).
before_dif <- c("mommy*" = -3.90, "daddy*" = -3.38, "baby" = -2.36, "no" = -1.86,
                "bye" = -1.80, "pet's name" = -1.73, "grandpa*" = -1.61, "nurse" = 1.43,
                "person" = 1.48, "cowboy" = 2.31)
vars %>% rowwise() %>%
  mutate(raw = rate(c24, next_var), repaired = rate(c24, var), other = rate(oth, var)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(dif %>% filter(form == "WS") %>% select(definition, version, d_diff_c) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = d_diff_c), by = "definition") %>%
  mutate(before = before_dif[definition]) %>%
  arrange(match(definition, words_2024)) %>%
  transmute(Item = definition, `2024 raw %` = raw, `2024 repaired %` = repaired,
            `Other ASD %` = other, `DIF before` = before,
            `DIF repaired` = round(main, 2), `DIF without 2024` = round(dx_confirmed, 2)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Production among children with 150–500 words, and centered DIF")
```

## Sensitivity: leaving out collection 2024

```{r sens}
ws <- dif %>% filter(form == "WS") %>%
  select(definition, category, version, d_diff_c, extreme) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = c(d_diff_c, extreme))
n_dx <- admins %>% filter(form == "WS", keep_items, one_per_child, item_profile_ok,
                          !asd_dx_unconfirmed) %>% nrow()
r_sens <- cor(ws$d_diff_c_main, ws$d_diff_c_dx_confirmed)
both <- ws %>% filter(extreme_main, extreme_dx_confirmed)
```

Collection 2024's diagnosis status is unconfirmed. Dropping it leaves `r n_dx` WS children.
The DIF profile correlates r = `r round(r_sens, 2)` with the main analysis; that run flags
`r sum(ws$extreme_dx_confirmed)` items, `r nrow(both)` of them also flagged in the main run.

```{r sens-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
ws %>% mutate(flag = case_when(extreme_main & extreme_dx_confirmed ~ "both",
                               extreme_main ~ "main only",
                               extreme_dx_confirmed ~ "without 2024 only",
                               TRUE ~ "neither")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(d_diff_c_main, d_diff_c_dx_confirmed, colour = flag)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = .7) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = ~ filter(.x, flag != "neither"),
                           aes(label = definition), size = 3, max.overlaps = 40,
                           show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(both = "black", `main only` = "#c0392b",
                                 `without 2024 only` = "#2471a3", neither = "grey80"),
                      name = "Flagged in") +
  labs(x = "Centered DIF, main", y = "Centered DIF, without 2024") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r robust}
both %>% arrange(d_diff_c_main) %>%
  transmute(Item = definition, Section = category,
            Main = round(d_diff_c_main, 2), `Without 2024` = round(d_diff_c_dx_confirmed, 2)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Items flagged in both analyses")
```

WG is unaffected: r = `r round(with(filter(dif, form == "WG") %>% select(definition, version, d_diff_c) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = d_diff_c), cor(main, dx_confirmed)), 2)` with and without the unconfirmed collections.

## Network analyses on the same data

From `03_networks.Rmd` (312 CDI:WS nouns).

```{r aoa, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
aoa_w <- e$aoa %>% filter(definition %in% e$words$definition) %>%
  select(definition, group, aoa) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = aoa)
ggplot(aoa_w, aes(TD, ASD)) + geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = .5) +
  labs(x = "TD age of acquisition (mo)", y = "ASD age of acquisition (mo)",
       subtitle = sprintf("r = %.2f; median AoA %.1f (ASD) vs %.1f (TD)",
                          cor(aoa_w$TD, aoa_w$ASD, use = "complete"),
                          median(aoa_w$ASD, na.rm = TRUE), median(aoa_w$TD, na.rm = TRUE)))
```

```{r static, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
e$static_coefs %>%
  ggplot(aes(term, estimate, colour = group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), position = position_dodge(.4)) +
  facet_wrap(~model) + coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Effect on standardized AoA (95% CI)", colour = NULL)
```

```{r growth}
e$growth_fits %>%
  select(model, predictor, group, estimate, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = c(estimate, se)) %>%
  mutate(z_diff = (estimate_ASD - estimate_TD) / sqrt(se_ASD^2 + se_TD^2),
         p_diff = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_diff))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  kable(caption = "Growth models: softmax weight per predictor, and Wald test of the group difference")
```

Children with ASD learn the same nouns in nearly the same order, about 4–5 months later.
Preferential acquisition (degree in the full network) predicts which nouns are learned next
in both groups; preferential attachment does not; group differences are within noise.

## Limitations and next steps

- The 2 SD flag is descriptive. Next: likelihood-ratio DIF tests against an anchor set
  (`mirt::DIF`) and bootstrap intervals.
- The samples differ in age at the same vocabulary size. Next: age- or vocabulary-matched
  TD subsamples, or age as a covariate.
- Section-level patterns need a formal model (centered DIF ~ section or word properties).
- Few ASD collections, and WG is dominated by collection 19. Next: leave-one-collection-out reruns.
- The 2024 repair is inferred from the data; confirm it (and the children's diagnosis status)
  with the submitter.
- Rasch only. Next: check whether a 2PL changes which items are flagged.
